fullContent:
Kasturyadi Gutika (Vati) 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam Gutika Prakarana 8, AFI. Vol. 1, 12:4 
 Introduction 
 Kasturyadi Gutika (Vati) is an herbal formulation that is made up from very efficient herbs. This formulation is known to treat the problems related to respiratory and gastric ailments. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kasthuri – Musk 
 Kiratatikta – Swertia chirata 
 Puzu – Caveat cat semen 
 Rasna- Pluchea lanceolata 
 Kanta Bhasma – Loha Bhasma 
 Jatiphala – Myristica fragrans 
 Karpura – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Yavakshara – Hordeum vulgare 
 SarjikaKshara 
 Krishna Jeeraka – Nigella sativa 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Twak – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Ela – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Patra – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica 
 Gairika – Red Ochre 
 Hiravi – Garcinia morella 
 Jiraka – Cuminum cyminum 
 Amalaki – Emblica officinalis / Phyllanthus emblica 
 Akarakarabha – Anacyclus pyrethrum 
 Shatahva – Indian Dill (fruit) – Anethum sowa / Peucedanum graveolens 
 Yashti – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Lavanga – Syzygium aromaticum 
 Toya – Pavonia odorata 
 Rasa – Purified and Processed Mercury 
 Yavani – Trachyspermum roxburghianum 
 Paranki – Boswellia serrata 
 Chandana – Santalum album 
 Vacha – Acorus calamus 
 Kankola – Piper cubeba 
 Shunti – Zingiber officinalis 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Shuddha Tankan – Borax 
 Anjana – Aqueous extract of Berberis aristata 
 Chakramarda – Cassia tora 
 Hingula – Purified Cinnabar 
 Vatsanabha – Aconitum ferox (purified) 
 Manashila – Purified realgar 
 Water / Cow milk / Juice extract of Bhringraj – Eclipta alba 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients up to 10 grams. 
 Powder all the ingredients and mix with water or cow milk to make its paste. 
 Now take the quantity of 125 mg and make its pills. 
 
 Dose 
 One to two tablets two times a day, before or after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Cold and cough 
 Fever 
 Vomiting 
 Hiccups 
 Bronchitis 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Avoid pregnancy and lactation. 
 Overdose can cause burning sensations. 
 Take under medical prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
